about: 재고1 원본 재기 — 판매입력은 단가 0 인 줄도 저장한다(원본 2026-10-21 실측). API 로 재고 5 를 구매로 넣고 단가 0 판매를 올려 200 을 보고 둘 다 지운다.

shots.name: 단가 0 판매 저장 → 지움
steps: js:(async () => { const H = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const g = async (u) => (await fetch(u, { headers: H })).json(); const [ps, its, whs] = await Promise.all([g('/api/partners'), g('/api/items'), g('/api/warehouses')]); const today = new Date(Date.now() - new Date().getTimezoneOffset() * 6e4).toISOString().slice(0, 10); const it = its.find((i) => !i.lotManaged && i.active !== false); const wh = whs[0]; const cu = ps.find((p) => p.type !== 'SUPPLIER'); const su = ps.find((p) => p.type !== 'CUSTOMER') || ps[0]; const pu = await (await fetch('/api/purchases', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ partnerId: su.id, warehouseId: wh.id, purchaseDate: today, remark: 'QA재고1', lines: [{ itemId: it.id, quantity: 5, unitPrice: 10 }] }) })).json(); const r = await fetch('/api/sales', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ partnerId: cu.id, warehouseId: wh.id, saleDate: today, remark: 'QA재고1 단가0', lines: [{ itemId: it.id, quantity: 1, unitPrice: 0 }] }) }); const b = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); sessionStorage.setItem('zp', JSON.stringify({ st: r.status })); if (b.id) await fetch('/api/sales/' + b.id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); if (pu.id) await fetch('/api/purchases/' + pu.id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); return true })()
